calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm, s.format, s.region,
  (SELECT round(sum(r.net_sales),0) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=s.store_id AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AS net_sales_fy2025_26
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.close_date IS NULL
ORDER BY s.sqm DESC LIMIT 14
